providers.title: Depth-three lower bound beyond every square-root constant (OpenAI)
providers.scope: One polynomial-time language whose membership functions need OR-AND-OR circuits with more than 2^(A sqrt n) gates, for every constant A and every large n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Averaging over restrictions
providers.scope: The correlation of two functions on the cube is the average, over random restrictions, of the correlation of the restricted functions.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Restriction bound (OpenAI)
providers.scope: After a p-random restriction, a CNF of width k correlates with any function at most W times that function's best correlation with CNFs of width b, where the expectation of W is at most 1/(1-theta), whatever the number of clauses.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Paths
providers.scope: A path of clauses that are wide when chosen has bounded length and distinct indices, and its violated clauses are counted at every later step.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Peeling
providers.scope: The remaining correction of a path equals its term minus the remaining corrections of its one-step extensions.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite expansion
providers.scope: A restricted CNF equals a narrow CNF plus a finite alternating sum of path fractions.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Marker mixture
providers.scope: The conjunction of the clauses before the first of c markers in a random order holds with probability c/(c+w) at a point violating w of the clauses.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Path terms as averages
providers.scope: Each path term is a positive weight times an average of CNFs of width at most b.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Reweighting
providers.scope: The expected total weight of the paths of a given length equals an expectation over a full random assignment of reciprocal counts of violated clauses.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Backward counting
providers.scope: The total weight of s reverse steps from any state is at most theta^s, because each step averages over the violated clauses.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sparse partition
providers.scope: A CNF of width b on m variables is a sum of at most 2^(eta m) CNFs of width b with disjoint supports and at most M m clauses each.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sunflower lemma (Erdős and Rado)
providers.scope: More than s!(r-1)^s distinct sets of size s contain a sunflower with r members.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Branching identity
providers.scope: Inserting the core, or the petals with the core false, splits the conjunction into two functions with disjoint supports.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Occurrence bound
providers.scope: Without an eligible sunflower at size i, every literal lies in at most e_i clauses of size i.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Added clauses
providers.scope: At every state each literal lies in at most e_u + 1 added clauses of size u.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Insertion budget
providers.scope: The number of inserted clauses of size u is at most (e_u+1)(2m + the number of smaller insertions).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Strings with few ones
providers.scope: At most 2^(N h(x)) binary strings of length N have at most N x ones, for x at most 1/2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A field as a quotient
providers.scope: For every r there is a monic polynomial P of degree r over the field with two elements whose quotient ring is a field.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The parameters
providers.scope: For d at least 64 the parameters r and t satisfy the stated bounds and the four blocks fit into the input.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Deciding membership
providers.scope: Membership is decided with a polynomial number of bit operations, for every monic modulus.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform hash values
providers.scope: The hash of every nonzero vector is uniformly distributed.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Injectivity
providers.scope: The hash is injective on a restricted cube of dimension m except with probability at most 2^(m-r).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Interpolation
providers.scope: The values of a random polynomial of degree below t at up to t distinct points of a field are independent and uniform.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Limited independence of a slice
providers.scope: When the hash is injective on a restricted cube, the signs of a random slice there are unbiased and t-wise independent.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Hard slices (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Some setting of the parameter bits gives a slice whose sign has correlation at most 2^(-|T|/8) with every CNF of width b on most random restrictions.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Number of sparse tests
providers.scope: There are at most 2^(M m (1 + b log(2m+1))) CNFs of width b with at most M m clauses on m variables.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Moment bound
providers.scope: For t-wise independent unbiased signs and even t, the t-th moment of a signed sum over a cube of dimension m is at most t^t 2^(m t/2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: All narrow tests
providers.scope: Under a condition on m and t, a random slice has correlation at most 2^(-m/8) with every CNF of width b, except with probability 2^(-m t/8).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Size of the live set
providers.scope: The number of live variables lies between half and twice its mean except with probability 2 * 2^(-m_0/16).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Choice of the width
providers.scope: A width b depending only on A makes the parameter theta of the restriction bound at most 1/2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Correlation with wide CNFs
providers.scope: A hard slice has correlation at most 6 * 2^(-m_0/16) with every CNF of width k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Balance
providers.scope: A hard slice accepts at least a quarter of its inputs.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Small circuits accept little
providers.scope: A depth-three circuit with S gates computing a hard slice accepts at most a 6 S 2^(-m_0/16) + S^2 2^(-k) fraction of the inputs.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The lower bound (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every A the language needs depth-three circuits with more than 2^(A sqrt n) gates at all large lengths n, and it is decided in polynomial time.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
